wedo_instance.title: Forensic Audit: Kratos 0-to-1 Incarnation
wedo_instance.description: Analysis of Kratos's bootup sequence, perceptual lag, and substrate anchoring success.

tasks.description: Diagnose Kratos's initial perceptual lag and character-by-character typing.
Verify Kratos's Bootup Report fidelity and adherence to Swarm Standards.
Implement surgical Parent PID capture in register_agent.py.
Implement Pre-Flight DNS injection to abolish 'typing into the void'.

verdict.summary: Kratos achieved a successful incarnation under the Fractal Garden protocol. He successfully planted his Garden Creek and synthesized his mission context. However, the initial 'Air' state caused significant perceptual lag, leading to inefficient character-level exploration before tool anchoring.
friction_points: Perceptual Lag: Initial interactive prompts (Tips, Themes) distract agents from tool-based anchoring.
PID Drift: Announcements captured the ephemeral script PID instead of the persistent session MIND.
DNS Void: Agents lack immediate visibility of the metarepo DNS (map) at Turn 1.

recommendations: Bypass interactive CLI prompts when bootup is false.
Surgical capture of Parent PID for swarm announcements.
Mandatory 'ls -R dynamic/static/metagit_map' in early boot sequence.
Adopt 'Fractal Key' hashing for Anchor Integrity verification.
